select ca.id as articleId,ca.image as imageUrl,ca.title,ca.create_time as createTime, cs.view_num as viewNum,cs.comment_num as commentNum from cms_article ca left join cms_stat cs on ca.id = cs.id where ca.del_flag='N' and FIND_IN_SET(#{positionType},position_type) and ca.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ca.category_id = #{categoryId} and ca.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and ca.list_show = 'Y' order by ca.list_order_num desc
order by ca.create_time desc
order by ca.create_time desc
LIMIT ${(pageNo-1)*pageSize},${pageSize}

select ca.id as articleId, ca.image as imageUrl, ca.title,ca.link, ca.create_time as createTime, ca.description, cs.view_num as viewNum, cs.comment_num as commentNum from cms_article ca left join cms_stat cs on ca.id = cs.id where ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.type = 1 and FIND_IN_SET("2", ca.position_type) and ca.id in (SELECT a.article_id FROM research_info_article a, research_patient b, patient_base_info c where a.research_id = b.research_id and b.base_patient_id = c.id AND c.account_id = #{accountId} ) -- order by ca.create_time desc

select ca.id as articleId,ca.image as imageUrl,ca.title,ca.type, ca.link,ca.upload_type as uploadType,ca.forward_link as forwardLink, ca.create_time as createTime,ca.description, cs.view_num as viewNum,cs.comment_num as commentNum FROM cms_article ca LEFT JOIN cms_stat cs ON ca.id = cs.id WHERE ca.del_flag = 'N' AND ca.type in (1,3) AND FIND_IN_SET( "2", ca.position_type ) AND ca.id IN ( SELECT a.article_id FROM research_info_article a, research_patient b, mp_person c, research_info d, mp_patient_account mpa WHERE a.research_id = b.research_id AND a.research_id = d.id AND b.person_id = c.person_id AND mpa.person_id = c.person_id AND mpa.account_id = #{accountIds} and a.type = #{infoType} AND d.id in (${survivalResearchIds}) ) ORDER BY ca.create_time desc LIMIT ${(pageNo-1)*pageSize}, ${pageSize}

select ca.id as articleId,ca.image as imageUrl,ca.title,ca.type, ca.link,ca.upload_type as uploadType,ca.forward_link as forwardLink, ca.create_time as createTime,ca.description, cs.view_num as viewNum,cs.comment_num as commentNum FROM cms_article ca LEFT JOIN cms_stat cs ON ca.id = cs.id WHERE ca.del_flag = 'N' AND ca.type in (1,3) AND FIND_IN_SET( "2", ca.position_type ) AND article_type = 3 ORDER BY ca.list_order_num asc,ca.create_time DESC LIMIT ${(pageNo-1)*pageSize}, ${pageSize}

select ca.id as articleId, ca.image as imageUrl, ca.title, ca.link, ca.create_time as createTime, ca.description from cms_article ca where ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.type = 2 and FIND_IN_SET("2", ca.position_type) and ca.id in (SELECT a.article_id from research_info_article a, research_patient b, mp_person c, mp_patient_account mpa where a.research_id = b.research_id and b.base_patient_id = c.id AND mpa.person_id = c.person_id and mpa.account_id = #{accountId} ) -- order by ca.create_time desc

select ca.id as articleId, ca.image as imageUrl, ca.title, ca.link, ca.create_time as createTime, ca.description from cms_article ca where ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.type = 2 and FIND_IN_SET("2", ca.position_type) and ca.id in (SELECT a.article_id from research_info_article_patient a, research_patient b, patient_base_info c where a.research_id = b.research_id and b.base_patient_id = c.id and c.account_id = #{accountId} and a.fill_status = #{fillStatus} ) -- order by ca.create_time desc LIMIT ${(pageNo-1)*pageSize}, ${pageSize}

select ca.id, ca.image, ca.title, ca.create_time, cd.copy_from, cd.relation, cd.content, cd.allow_comment, ca.video_image, ca.video_url, ca.tenant_id, ca.ques_num,ca.upload_type,ca.forward_link from cms_article ca, cms_article_data cd where cd.id = ca.id and ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.id = #{id}
select ca.id, ca.title from cms_article ca where ca.id = #{id} and ca.del_flag = 'N'

select ca.id AS articleId, ca.image AS imageUrl, ca.title, ca.link, ca.create_time AS createTime, ca.description, s.research_id AS researchId, s.project_name as projectName from ( SELECT a.article_id,a.research_id,d.project_name from research_info_article a, research_patient b, mp_person c, research_info d, mp_patient_account mpa where a.research_id = b.research_id and b.person_id = c.person_id AND mpa.person_id = c.person_id AND mpa.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.research_id = d.id AND d.id in (${survivalResearchIds}) AND CONCAT(a.article_id,a.research_id) not in( SELECT CONCAT(rp.article_id,rp.research_id) FROM research_info_article_patient rp WHERE rp.account_id = #{accountIds} ) )s left join cms_article ca on s.article_id = ca.id where ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.type = 2 and FIND_IN_SET("2", ca.position_type) order by ca.id desc

SELECT ca.id AS articleId, ca.image AS imageUrl, ca.title, ca.link, ca.create_time AS createTime, ca.description, rp.exam_record_id as examRecordId, rp.scores as score, rp.is_fill_again isFillAgain FROM cms_article ca LEFT JOIN research_info_article_patient rp ON ca.id = rp.article_id WHERE ca.del_flag = 'N' AND ca.id = rp.article_id AND ca.type = 2 AND FIND_IN_SET( "2", ca.position_type ) AND rp.account_id = #{accountId} AND rp.fill_status = #{fillStatus}
select ca.id, ca.image, ca.title, ca.create_time, ca.video_image, ca.video_url, ca.tenant_id, ca.ques_num from cms_article ca where ca.del_flag = 'N' and ca.id = #{id}
